_comment: News watcher sources. Checked 22.10.2026, evidence in docs/news-quellen.md and docs/news-quellen-pruefung.json. rights: free = verdict use and the terms also carry a public, non-commercial page; private = with care, only while the install is private. filter: cannabis = only items matching the cannabis keywords; garden = home-gardening or cannabis keywords; all = every item (the drop list for consumption and sale still applies). Titles and links only: no teaser, no full text, no images, for every source. A new source comes in only after the same check, never from the page. private = the terms carry personal or non-commercial use only (also Bundesrat, BGH and beck-aktuell, whose verdict was use); fetched and shown only when the install is explicitly private. dedupe: link+guid (default) or link+date for feeds whose guid is a page that comes back changed. window_hours: how far back the feed reaches; a longer pause between two fetches is shown as a possible gap. checked: the date terms and robots.txt were last read; after 90 days the view asks for a recheck.

sources.name: BMG Pressemitteilungen
sources.notes: Official source for KCanG and MedCanG law and the EKOCAN evaluation. Rare: 2 cannabis items in at least 122. Impressum allows quoting unchanged with source. No images.

sources.name: BMG Aktuelle Meldungen
sources.notes: Reserve feed. Last cannabis item 07.08.2024. Full text sits in content:encoded and is never read.

sources.name: BMG Seitenänderungen
sources.notes: Page changes of the last 30 days (about 13 days window). The keyword match also reads the link path, which stands in for the path filter the check suggested. Unproven that the cannabis and EKOCAN pages show up here. The guid is the page URL and a changed page returns with a new date: deduped by link plus date, the newer version replaces the older one.

sources.name: BundesratKOMPAKT
sources.notes: Plenary results, only on session days. robots.txt crawl-delay 30 s. Impressum: download for personal use only. Verdict use, but rights private: personal use only.

sources.name: Bundesrat, Beratungsvorgänge (Neueingänge)
sources.notes: Bills and ordinances reaching the Bundesrat. Drucksachen are official works: title unchanged with source and link. Feed date unreliable (444/26 carried 17.12.2026), so a date in the future falls back to first seen. robots.txt crawl-delay 30 s. Verdict use, but rights private: the Impressum allows download for personal use only.

sources.name: Bundesgesetzblatt Teil I
sources.attribution: Bundesgesetzblatt Teil I (Copyright by Bundesministerium der Justiz)
sources.notes: Official promulgation (Art. 82 GG); laws are not protected (section 5 UrhG). No teaser, no guid, dates as YYYY-MM-DD. A title filter misses cannabis rules hidden in omnibus laws. robots.txt crawl-delay 30 s on recht.bund.de.

sources.name: BGH Pressemitteilungen
sources.notes: The attribution is required word for word, with the date of the press release. Commercial use not permitted. No teaser: title only. 1 cannabis item in 100. Verdict use, but rights private: no commercial use. Items without a feed date are not stored, the required source line needs the date. robots.txt crawl-delay 30 s.

sources.name: beck-aktuell. HEUTE IM RECHT
sources.notes: Terms allow headline and teaser with link and clear source, no commercial use, no images. dpa texts must not be stored: only cannabis matches are kept. Window about one day (20 items); the check recommends every 8 hours, this build fetches daily. Verdict use, but rights private: no commercial use.

sources.name: Journal für Kulturpflanzen (Julius Kühn-Institut)
sources.attribution: Journal für Kulturpflanzen, Julius Kühn-Institut (CC BY 4.0; Autoren und vollständige Zitierangabe beim Original)
sources.notes: CC BY 4.0: authors, title, year, journal, volume, issue and pages belong to a full citation; the article page behind the link carries them. Mostly professional plant protection and fruit growing, hence the garden filter. One industrial hemp item.

sources.name: Landwirtschaftskammer Niedersachsen, Gartenbau
sources.notes: Headlines and teasers with active link and source allowed, no images, links in a new window, never in a frame. The chamber can withdraw this without reason: switch active off then. Professional horticulture, hence the garden filter. Feed not ordered by date.

sources.name: Deutscher Hanfverband
sources.notes: With care: no reuse clause found, private use only. Advocacy, label it as such. The server throttles with HTTP 429: fetched alone, never in parallel (the watcher is sequential), and a 429 pauses it for 6 hours. Every item is cannabis policy, so no keyword filter; the drop list still removes sale and consumption items.

sources.name: Bundestag, hib (heute im bundestag)
sources.notes: With care: Impressum allows content for private use only, otherwise written consent. Window only 15 items of one day: a daily fetch misses items.

sources.name: Bundestag, Themenfeed Gesundheit
sources.notes: With care: same private-use condition as hib. No dates in the feed (first seen is used). Media library entries are dropped.

sources.name: Legal Tribune Online
sources.notes: With care: only for own, non-commercial purposes, unchanged. Only this plain feed URL without parameters: robots.txt blocks the section feeds.

disabled.name: bioRxiv: Plant Biology
disabled.reason: Verdict use, but no value here: 0 cannabis items in the window, general plant biology is noise, and each author picks the preprint licence (up to no reuse).

disabled.name: BVerwG Pressemitteilungen
disabled.reason: Verdict use, but no value here: 0 cannabis items from 29.04. to 22.10.2026, the description is only the file number.

excluded: Rejected or needing permission, never fetched: Pharmazeutische Zeitung, krautinvest, G-BA, BIOEG, ZDFheute, Frontiers, US extension blogs (NC State, Maryland, Illinois), BfArM, PLOS, Elsevier, PubMed, idw, taz, Business of Cannabis, MJBizDaily, and the consumption sites (Hanf Journal, Leafly, Hanf Magazin).
